name: admin-5xx-errors
title: Admin application is repeatedly returning HTTP 5xx responses
description: The admin application has returned at least one HTTP 5xx response during each of the last five minutes.
investigation_steps: Review the matching logs to identify the failing request paths, status codes and errors.
Check the health of the admin ECS service and its running tasks.
Check for recent deployments or infrastructure changes that might have caused this.

query: fields @timestamp, status, request_method, request_uri, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, aws_request_id, @message, @logStream
